The Asrock B550 PG Velocita is a motherboard designed for AMD processors, specifically compatible with AMD Ryzen 3rd Gen series CPUs. This motherboard supports a maximum of 128 GB of memory through its 4 DIMM slots, with ECC and non-ECC options available. It features a Socket AM4 processor socket and supports a wide range of memory clock speeds from 2133 MHz to 4666 MHz. One of the standout features of the PG Velocita motherboard is its unbeatable heatsink armor, made from aluminum alloy to improve heat dissipation. It also includes dual M.2 sockets for high-speed SSDs, with support for PCIe Gen4 x4 and PCIe Gen3 x2/SATA3 modes. The motherboard's Hi-Density Power Connector reduces power loss and temperature, with 8+4 12V power connectors and a 24-pin ATX power connector. Additionally, the PG Velocita motherboard offers Nahimic Audio for an immersive listening experience and features 2oz copper PCB for stable signal traces and power shapes. It also supports ASRock's Polychrome RGB lighting for customizable aesthetics. With its focus on performance and appearance, the Asrock B550 PG Velocita is a high-end option for gamers looking for speed and reliability in their gaming experience.
